_comment: The command runner runs the whole Vitest suite per mutant (about 3 s). @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10 does not activate mutants under Vitest 5: csv.ts scored 1.4% with it, 76.6% with this. Two runs at a time with a 60 s timeout: at concurrency 4 on a 4-vCPU runner, 928 of 1,000 mutants timed out from CPU contention and counted as killed (98.8%). The command runs the test files that import these modules (billing.test.ts, the engine's 5,000 random timelines, is left out).

commandRunner.command: npx vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lib/validate.test.ts src/lib/validate-boundaries.test.ts src/lib/api-status.test.ts src/lib/csv.test.ts src/lib/share.test.ts src/lib/money.test.ts src/lib/parity-route.test.ts src/lib/stripe-import.test.ts src/lib/mcp.test.ts
